# `aitbc script list`

List available scripts in the script directory.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc script list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--script-dir` | text | `/opt/aitbc/scripts` | no | Scripts directory |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc script list
```
